Title: Almaty gets its first cable car line
URL: https://news.example.org/today

# Almaty gets its first cable car line

The city opened a 4 km cable car from Medeu to Shymbulak on Monday. Tickets cost 3 000 tenge; the line runs from 9:00
to 22:00. Read the interview with the engineers in [part 2](https://news.example.org/today/part-2), and see the photos
at https://cdn.other.example/story/2.
